text: Ryoma Tachibana born in 2010; Captain Rook is his later callsign, Mystery his technical room label.
A real old-Earth day Ryoma remembers. It is not the last ordinary day before his 2030 departure; the repeated room date is unexplained.
Departure at 20; speculative 1g-class drive and reversible cryosleep. No claim that this was achievable with real 2030 technology.

Known four-burn equations with a={{constants.a_m_s2:.2f}} [physics:constants.a_m_s2] m/s² give ship time {{trip1.ship_years:.6f}} [physics:trip1.ship_years] yr, gamma {{trip1.peak_gamma:.6f}} [physics:trip1.peak_gamma], beta {{trip1.peak_beta:.8f}} [physics:trip1.peak_beta] and turnaround {{trip1.turnaround_ly:.6f}} [physics:trip1.turnaround_ly] ly. Cryo assumption {{trip1.cryo_years:.6f}} [physics:trip1.cryo_years] yr leaves {{trip1.awake_years:.1f}} [physics:trip1.awake_years] awake yr; Earth/body is not gamma.

Ozone collapse during superflare/particle events plus geomagnetic weakening; UV crisis, crops fail, sealed habitats and famine follow. Supernova ~8 pc (~26 ly) ozone scenario considered and ruled out; the catastrophic solar outcome is fiction, not a certain prediction.

Alternate-history YR4 lunar strike, not an Earth strike; 53–67 m estimated size and 4.3% lunar chance refer to June 2025. Ejecta and Kessler cascade cripple launches for decades; later real-world estimates do not dictate this fictional branch.

Return after 60 Earth years and ~3 biological years to ruined Earth. Vella evacuation crew: Rook commander/repair; Hana Sato medicine/cryo; Imani Vale propulsion; Pavel Orlov navigation; Leena Das air/water.

Optical/radio confirmation received: fictional impactor 2090 BA1 has struck the old Earth. Light delay {{signal.delay_days:.6f}} [physics:signal.delay_days] days at receiver distance {{signal.receiver_distance_AU:.6f}} [physics:signal.receiver_distance_AU] AU; the living world is lost, not the planet’s rock.

Second straight-reference clock {{trip2.ship_years:.6f}} [physics:trip2.ship_years] yr, gamma {{trip2.peak_gamma:.6f}} [physics:trip2.peak_gamma]; actual multi-star clock {{route.ship_years:.6f}} [physics:route.ship_years] yr, gamma {{route.peak_gamma:.6f}} [physics:route.peak_gamma]. Actual cryo {{route.cryo_years:.6f}} [physics:route.cryo_years] yr leaves assumed {{route.awake_years:.1f}} [physics:route.awake_years] awake yr. The previous approximate gamma/ship-time estimates are superseded.

Neutron assist: Pavel and Imani killed by rupture; Leena dies sealing coolant; Hana later dies from cryosupport failure and exhausted medical oxygen. Rook sole survivor. AX-2198-047 / mission year 2198 records en-route re-registration, Captain Rook, crew one, not a new launch.

Dead probe ~30 ly from Luhman 16 yields fusion-core power for 3,700 air-service hours for one; later solo neutron assist nearly fatal. Claimed Voyager 7 plutonium reactor discovered on repairs; attribution uncertain.

Wormhole-like passage from 2199 to another universe’s Earth; mechanism unknown, arrival about five local months before room date. ~20+3+3=26 biological years, true as told to Iris; local residence shifts only rounding.
340-year claim conflicts with 2199−2010=189; preserve discrepancy without inventing an explanation. Optional local 16-year-old Ryoma remains an unverified possibility, not an established character.

Sirius shift {{sirius.angle_deg:.6f}} [physics:sirius.angle_deg] degrees versus proper motion {{sirius.proper_motion_deg:.6f}} [physics:sirius.proper_motion_deg] degrees. Conditional minimum displacement {{sirius.minimum_displacement_ly:.6f}} [physics:sirius.minimum_displacement_ly] ly; fixed transverse alternative {{sirius.fixed_transverse_displacement_ly:.6f}} [physics:sirius.fixed_transverse_displacement_ly] ly. Parallax, other universe and constructed sky remain open; no orbital clearance.

Captain’s timeline: after the crew losses, Ryoma retrieved one living glass flower from UB-7. Silica crust broke over brine, tearing his right glove seal; Vella guided him back with nine minutes suit air. Right-palm scar. Vella kept the specimen in hydroponics for {{flower.ship_years_to_arrival:.3f}} [physics:flower.ship_years_to_arrival] ship years until arrival; Ryoma later gave it to Iris on their first date.
